capabilities.description: Syncs completed playback and optionally manual watched marks to AniList, and imports mapped watch history.

fields.label: Sync manually marked watched items
fields.description: Also send items marked watched without being played. Completed playback always syncs.

fields.label: Playback completion threshold
fields.description: Playback must pass this percentage before AniList progress advances. Match Silo's watched threshold.

presentation.summary: Reliably synchronize completed anime with AniList through Silo's watch-provider pipeline.
presentation.description_markdown: Uses Silo's host-owned watch-sync pipeline for encrypted per-profile credentials, durable playback completion delivery, optional manual watched marks, retries, imports, and rich episode identity. Episode exports prefer the daily AniBridge v3 dataset, with an Anime-Lists and ARM fallback. Watch-history imports reverse-map AniList progress through AniBridge. AniList progress is monotonic and ambiguous mappings are rejected rather than guessed.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin and match the playback completion threshold to Silo's watched threshold. To connect a profile, open https://anilist.co/api/v2/oauth/authorize?client_id=49797&response_type=token, approve access, copy the access token AniList shows, then open Settings → Watch Providers → AniList, select Connect, and paste the token. Silo validates the token against AniList and shows the connected account. Tokens last about one year; reconnect when AniList reports the credential as expired.
